pages.text: The Soul Linker tool can be used to link the $(l:shadowthings:soul_core)Soul Core$() to different machines. $(br2)To link a machine to the core first right click the core $(o)(middle block of the structure)$() then right click any machine you want to connect. To reset the tool shift right click into the air. $(br)In case of linking to the Soul Furnace you need to click the controller block in the middle.

The Soul Linker tool can also be used to configure the $(l:shadowthings:soul_furnace)Soul Furnace$() $(l:shadowthings:soul_furnace_aio)Auto I/O.$() To configure auto I/O.$(br)First you need to right click the furnace controller block $(o)(middle)$(), then you can right click the $(l)input$() inventory, after that you right click the $(l)output$() inventory.
